# openmetadata_security_service (Data Source)

Looks up a single OpenMetadata security service by id or fully qualified name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openmetadata_security_service" "ranger" {
  fully_qualified_name = "ranger"
}

output "ranger_security_service_id" {
  value = data.openmetadata_security_service.ranger.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Security service fully qualified name. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.
- `id` (String) Security service UUID. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Markdown description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `name` (String) Security service name.
- `service_type` (String) OpenMetadata security service type such as Ranger.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.
